source: docs/plan/IMPORT-PIPELINE.md §5: the words by which a label says what its answer is, in ru. Lower-case, compared after NFKC as whole words or phrases; an entry ending in * matches the start of a word (telefon* → telefonnummer), one starting with * its end (*adress → postadress). Chinese and Japanese entries are matched by character pairs. formats: the validation a personnummer or organisation-number word proposes, applied only on a document detected as this language (CAVEATS #27).
